description: This file defines the RestJsonErrorParser class, which parses JSON-REST error responses in the AWS SDK for PHP. It processes HTTP responses to extract error information and normalize error data structures.

classes.name: RestJsonErrorParser
classes.description: Parses JSON-REST errors from AWS service responses; extends AbstractErrorParser and implements JSON error parsing logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with an optional API service description and JSON parser.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the response, extracts error data, and normalizes error information from the response.
